description:
Upload assets for PowerPoint (.pptx) generation: company template, logo, image, or document — or AI-generate an image.

Purposes:
• logo — company logo for chrome (PNG/JPG/SVG, max 5MB) → logo_id
• image — image for the Image component (max 10MB) → asset_id
• theme — company template PPTX → theme_id; slides with it render NATIVELY on the template (masters/layouts/chrome)
• generate_image — AI-generate via `prompt` → asset_id
• translate — PPTX to translate → deck job_id (requires `target_language`)
• pdf — PDF → editable slides; pass `target_language` to also translate
• recreate — image OF a slide → editable PPTX slide (honest annotate/preserve fallback). Use `image` to just place a picture

Files >3MB (pdf/translate/theme) — and recreate on chat hosts — omit `data`: a drop-zone appears in the result card; bytes never pass through the agent.

data.description: Base64-encoded file content. Required for logo/image/theme/translate. Optional for pdf — omit to get a drop-zone (recommended for files >3MB).

job_id.description: For purpose=brand: keep the look a recreate rendered in — pass that recreate's job_id and its exact kit is saved as yours (no upload, no charge).

position.description: Logo position: top-left / top-right / bottom-left / bottom-right

purpose.description: Asset type (required). brand = a .pptx/.potx corporate template imported as your brand kit (theme is the same thing under its old name).

quality.description: draft = Flux Schnell. balanced (default) = Gemini Flash Image. premium = GPT Image 2. Overridden by `model`.

target_language.description: Required for purpose=translate. Optional for purpose=pdf — chains pdf→pptx→translate in one call.

theme_id.description: For purpose=recreate: the brand kit or built-in theme to render the recreated slide in — your kit slug, `slug@version`, or a built-in id. Omit to keep the look of the source image.

name: upload_asset
title: Upload or Generate Asset
